metadata.scope: formal GMNER-correct but F2 subtype-wrong predictions
metadata.interpretation: A deterministic Train-prototype probe of visual subtype separability; not deployable accuracy and not a trained model
metadata.candidate_semantics: Only official gold-positive real R36 regions count as clean visual evidence; Fine Top-K controls whether such evidence is reachable without using a non-gold region

decision.freeze: F2 remains the formal FMNERG solution
evidence: Top-4 adds 5.33 pairwise and 4.67 sibling recoveries over formal region
Top-4, Top-8, Top-16, and full R36 have the same support ceiling
Full-R36 sibling-top1 support covers only 22.33% of visible subtype errors

prototype_bank.method: IoU-weighted mean of normalized Train gold-positive R36 features, followed by one normalized centroid per subtype
